text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan's toenail is in horrible condition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the possibility of having to skip the Satsuki Sho dawns on us, she pleads with me to let her run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She claims that if she can't, she'll quit running altogether. She doesn't care what happens after the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I realize the extent of her determination. We decide to continue working towards the Satsuki Sho while we treat her toenail.
